'''2010 Worlds Day 3 Kyle Krueger LS Coruscant Night Club''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kyle Krueger]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 3).<ref name="pdf">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2010/2010+Worlds+D3.pdf 2010 Worlds Day 3.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org, page 12. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20201203002812/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/tournaments/Decklists/2010/2010+Worlds+D3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>

The list is a typed sheet headed "Kyle Krueger Day 3 LS" rather than the standard deck sheet. The sheet's Weapons header says (4) but lists five weapons, which with the other sections totals 60 cards. "Sense" is left unlinked because the sheet does not say which version.

== Deck info ==

* '''Side:''' Light
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Anger, Fear, Aggression (V) (Virtual Block 4)|Anger, Fear, Aggression (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.1]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
